values.note: ReserveAmerica sells 234 campsites (plus 6 yurts, 5 group sites and a pavilion): Area 1 - Loop 1 has 88, Area 2 - Loop 2 has 146. 155 are tent-only, 60 standard non-electric, 10 pop-up/tent and 9 RV/trailer non-electric. 18 back-ins rated 30 ft take a 23-ft rig - 9 in Area 1 (040D, 041D, 043D, 044D, 077C, 078C, 083C, 089C, 090C) and 9 in Area 2 (102B, 123B, 157B, 209A, 210A, 211A, 217D, 233C, 248E); the other RV-type sites are rated 20 ft or carry no length.

note: MA DCR state forest at the gateway to Cape Cod: two wooded camping areas in pitch pine and scrub oak, with more than 15 miles of roads and trails for hiking and horseback riding; playground and pavilion in Area 2. Also six yurts and group sites. Single campground despite appearing as both state and dnr rows in RV Life. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica + mass.gov: $17/$54 (2026 table), no hookups, dump station, flush toilets + showers, reservations required, 2026 season 5/7-11/21 with 10/29-11/21 Thu/Fri/Sat only (RA 'Peak 5/7-10/28, Non Peak 10/29-11/21'; matches stored; no 2027 schedule posted), 285 sites, max 30 ft (18 back-ins rated 30 ft, 9 per area), phone 508-888-0351. Added pull_through false, sites note with RA's real counts (Area 1 88 / Area 2 146 sites, not ~47/112), RA booking url; hookups/facilities/sites/booking moved derived -> manual (camp_store left as is: RA lists 'Concession'). Note cleaned of field facts and the wrong area counts. Pin sits inside the larger of the two camping polygons (RA GPS is in the other, ~1 km NW); not changed. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Pin (informational, not changed): OSM draws the campground as two separate polygons ~1 km apart. The stored pin (41.75559, -70.51644) is inside the larger, south-eastern one; RA's GPS (41.76306, -70.52361) is in the smaller north-western one near Route 130. A site-weighted centroid would fall between them (~41.759, -70.520, ~350 m from the pin), so the pin is acceptable.
